description: This file sets up a conversational bot pipeline using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, language model, text-to-speech, and transport mechanisms, with custom function handling and event-driven architecture.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema defining a function for LLM to call, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining tools available to the LLM, such as weather fetching.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns in conversations, used for turn stopping strategies.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on Silero models.

classes.name: VADParams
classes.description: Parameters for VAD analysis, such as stop seconds.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame representing an LLM run in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters and timeout settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Parameters for configuring a pipeline, such as metrics and usage tracking.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Executes the pipeline, manages signals and task lifecycle.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object holding conversation messages and tools.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for user message aggregation, including turn strategies.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Strategies for handling user turns, including stop strategies.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to stop user turn analysis based on turn analyzer.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch weather data via a function call.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the pipeline.
